## K-382-1 · C:382-384 · identity

**Pass.** maintenance-internal
**Claim.** "The XPC host and its bundle-local `pw-probe-runner` use an exact SHA-256 source identity, generated by generate_worker_identity.py."
**Mechanism.** `identity(root)` computes SHA-256 over a domain prefix and the framed inputs (row 21). `render_all` writes the 64-hex value and its 32 octets into three marked regions: C (`PW_WORKER_ABI_IDENTITY_HEX`, `PW_WORKER_ABI_IDENTITY[32]`), Swift (`PWShmLayout.abiIdentityHex`, `abiIdentity`), Python (`WORKER_IDENTITY`). The host copies its constant into the shared header before spawn; the worker compares the header bytes with its constant by `memcmp` (rows 27-28). "Exact" is byte equality of 32 bytes; no ordering or range is used anywhere.
**Who acts.** Generator at maintainer time; host and worker at run time — stated in the sentence: partly (who compares is left to later sentences).
**Compared with what.** Header bytes 64-95 against each side's compiled constant — stated in the sentence: no.
**Boundary.** Generated before the build; compared after spawn, before the worker's first shared write — stated in the sentence: no.
**Consequence.** Rows 28 and 30 — stated in the sentence: no.
**Sources.** `docs/generate_worker_identity.py` : `identity` (45-56), `render_all` (59-75); `controller/tools/pw_probe_runner/pw_probe_runner_abi.h` (47-50); `runner/Sources/PWRunnerCore/CWorker.swift` (51-54); `tests/lib/contract.py` (3-5).
**Checks.** `tests/suites/runner_abi_layout/run.sh` (152-172) — rule — default (`runner_abi_layout/c_swift_layout_agreement`, requires clang) — compiles a C printer against the header, reads the Swift constant as text and imports `contract.py`; fails unless all three are equal — reaches the claim: yes for agreement of the copies. `tests/suites/smoke/pw_specimen_smoke.sh` (79-81) — test — default — signed product: `worker_evidence.abi_identity` in a live run equals `contract.WORKER_IDENTITY` — reaches: yes for the host's compiled value. `build.sh` (687-689) with `tests/lib/build_provenance.py` `worker_identity_admitted` (1493-1506) — rule at build time — runs the built worker's `--version` and compares `abi_identity=` with the generated value.
**Status.** owned
**Grade.** test read
**Against the leads.** Agree.
**Not found / not read.** "Bundle-local" placement was taken from `tests/suites/runner_c_worker_harness/run.sh:12` (`…/PWRunner.xpc/Contents/MacOS/pw-probe-runner`); the build's embed step was not read.

## K-384-1 · C:384-385 · denial

**Claim.** "There is no worker ABI ordinal or compatibility negotiation."
**Mechanism.** The header's first word is a fixed magic (`PW_SHM_ABI_MAGIC 0x50574944u`), not a version number; the only version-like comparison in the worker's startup is the magic inequality and the 32-byte `memcmp`, with a single outcome on mismatch (exit 4). **Compared with what.** n/a.

Absence is otherwise established by reading the source only.

## K-407-1 · C:407-408 · admission
